jobs.title: Product Manager - Mission Agents
jobs.description:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

We’re hiring a Product Manager for our Mission Agents team.

This team owns the systems that turn user intent into execution - from chat and tasking to persistent agent workflows. You will define how users delegate work to software, how those systems operate on real-world data, and how they are monitored, constrained, and improved over time.

This is not a traditional roadmap role. You will take in incomplete, conflicting inputs from users, stakeholders, data, and systems - and decide what we should actually build.

You will work closely with operators, forward deployed engineers, and engineering teams to identify high-leverage problems and drive them through to shipped capability. You will often need to ignore loud or conflicting inputs and make decisions that others disagree with.

This role reports to the CTO and operates at the intersection of mission, product, and engineering. Success is measured by whether we build the right things and those things create real mission impact.

What you'll do

- Synthesize signal into direction. Take in messy, conflicting inputs and determine what actually matters.

- Define how agents behave. Shape primitives like objectives, constraints, trust tiers, and evaluation criteria.

- Improve output quality. Drive systematic improvements across models, memory, and workflows.

- Own product direction end-to-end. Turn ambiguous problems into concrete bets and drive them through delivery.

- Work directly with users. Build deep intuition for real-world workflows and needs.

- Translate mission signal into product direction. Take in real-world user signal and translate it into clear product direction, including pushing back when needed.

- Partner with engineering. Shape solutions that are both impactful and technically sound.

- Drive alignment in ambiguous situations. Bring clarity across stakeholders when perspectives conflict.

What you should have

- Strong product judgment. You consistently identify the right problems and make sound prioritization decisions.

- Ability to separate signal from noise. Y ou form independent, defensible opinions from incomplete and conflicting inputs.

- Experience with complex systems or platforms. You’ve worked on products where behavior emerges from underlying primitives.

- Experience operating under real constraints. You’ve shipped products where security, infrastructure, or deployment realities shaped decisions.

- High ownership and bias toward action. You take responsibility for outcomes and push work through to completion.

- Technical fluency. You can engage with engineers and understand system constraints and tradeoffs.

- Clear, direct communication. You can articulate decisions, tradeoffs, and reasoning in a way others can act on.

Nice to have

- Experience working with operational or mission-driven users

- Experience with LLM-based systems

- Experience with product analytics (e.g., SQL)

- Experience rapidly prototyping ideas (Figma, AI coding tools, etc.)

- Exposure to constrained or high-security environments

- Active Security clearance (or ability to obtain one) and willingness to travel onsite

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

- Health, dental, and vision insurance

- 100% remote first culture. You can work from anywhere in the US and all full time employees have WeWork access

- Unlimited PTO including competitive vacation and holiday schedules

- Lifestyle stipends - Monthly mental health, wellness & fitness stipend, in-home office setup stipend and family planning assistance

- Salary top-up during military reserve duty

- Fully paid parental leave

- Child and pet care reimbursement during travel

#LI-Remote

Vannevar is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't feel like you're a perfect fit. If you're passionate about contributing to our mission, we'd love to hear from you!

IMPORTANT NOTICE
We are committed to protecting the privacy of all applicants. Official emails from the company will come from an @vannevarlabs.com domain. Under no circumstances will a legitimate representative from our company contact you to request passwords, financial information, or other sensitive personal data. Please be vigilant of potential scams.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

We’re hiring a Staff Technical Product Manager to lead definition and evolution of foundational platform capabilities spanning multiple engineering organizations. This role reports directly to the CTO and operates at the system level - shaping the structures and primitives that underpin our products rather than managing feature-level roadmaps.

You will own problems that cross organizational boundaries and cannot be solved within a single team. The objective of this role is improving structural coherence across the platform - defining durable system structures and primitives, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring they translate into real capability.

Operating in close partnership with engineering leadership, this role progressively assumes independent ownership of convergence and cross-organizational decision resolution. Execution coordination is part of the role, but performance is measured by durable system improvement and structural convergence.

Example problem spaces include:

- Authorization and policy models

- Identity and ownership boundaries

- Data access structures

- Platform abstractions and shared primitives

What you’ll do

- Define and evolve cross-platform system primitives and structures, translating mission and product needs into durable system behaviors and producing artifacts that clarify system intent (PRDs, specs, evaluation criteria)

- Drive resolution of structural problems spanning multiple engineering organizations

- Build alignment across engineering leadership, design, and mission stakeholders

- Maintain convergence momentum across teams implementing shared capabilities

- Partner with Engineering Managers to translate structural intent into execution plans and hold convergence through delivery

- Stay engaged through delivery to ensure implementations converge on intended outcomes

- Identify architectural divergence early and drive corrective action

- Identify and drive resolution of cross-team dependencies arising from shared platform primitives and structural initiatives

What we’re looking for

- Experience operating at Staff level in TPM, product architecture, or engineer-to-PM hybrid roles

- Strong systems reasoning across distributed systems, identity/authorization, or platform architecture

- Demonstrated success shaping technical direction across multiple teams

- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-organizational technical initiatives through to outcome - articulating tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and landing durable decisions

- Credible communicator able to influence senior engineers and technical leadership across domains without relying on formal authority structures

- High ownership mindset in ambiguous environments

- Outstanding driver and communicator who identifies structural risks early - such as unclear ownership, missing definitions, or weak execution setup - and intervenes to correct course

Nice to have

- Background in platform, infrastructure, or security domains

- Experience with policy or authorization systems

- Multi-tenant or regulated environment exposure

- Experience operating in environments with decentralized ownership or competing platform abstractions

What we offer

Comprehensive Benefits

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

- Health, dental, and vision insurance

- Remote friendly with WeWork access

- Unlimited PTO, shared downtime during the federal holiday calendar, and company-wide off time at the end of each year

- 401(k) match

- Lifestyle & wellbeing stipends

- Salary top-up during military reserve duty

- Fully paid parental leave

- Child and pet care reimbursement during travel
